title: 15th Sitting of second session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/15/2/2025).
Approval of the minutes of three previous sittings (minutes Nos. 9/2/2025 to 11/2/2025).

Question by Galolhu South MP Meekail Ahmed Naseem to the Minister of Foreign Affairs, Dr Abdulla Khaleel: whether "Prince Fahad Saud Al-Shalan", whom President Dr Mohamed Muizzu met on 5 May 2025 and who was described as a member of the Saudi royal family, actually belongs to that family; why the Saudi Embassy did not take part in the meeting; and, if the description was untrue, whether it could harm Maldives-Saudi Arabia relations.

From the Speaker's desk: the President's request to extend the term of Children's Ombudsperson Niumath Shafeeq, under Article 117 of Law No. 19/2019 (Child Rights Protection Act), is sent to the relevant standing committee for review.
First reading of the government-sponsored Trademark Bill, submitted by Maduvvari MP Ahmed Zahir.
Preliminary debate on the government-sponsored Trademark Bill, submitted by Maduvvari MP Ahmed Zahir.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting was scheduled to question the Foreign Minister about a disputed Saudi "prince" the President met, send the Children's Ombudsperson's term extension to committee, and introduce and begin debating the Trademark Bill.
